cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from gen2 import gen
from invariants import check
rng = random.Random(31337)
bad=0
for trial in range(6):
    doc = gen(rng)
    # force max size
    doc["packets"] = [dict(p) for p in doc["packets"]]
    base = doc["packets"]
    if base:
        while len(doc["packets"]) < 20000:
            last = doc["packets"][-1]
            import copy
            np = copy.deepcopy(last)
            np["time"] = min(10**12, last["time"] + rng.choice([0,1,1000]))
            doc["packets"].append(np)
    while len(doc["connections"]) < 2048:
        i=len(doc["connections"])
        doc["connections"].append({"id":"x%04d"%i,"slot":rng.randint(0,doc["config"]["slots"]-1),
                                   "label":rng.randint(0,doc["model"]["classes"]-1),"split":"eval"})
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
    el=time.time()-t0
    out = json.loads(p.stdout)
    if "error" in out:
        print("TRIAL", trial, "rejected!", len(doc["packets"])); bad+=1; continue
    errs = check(doc, out)
    print("trial", trial, "pkts", len(doc["packets"]), "out bytes", len(p.stdout), "time %.2f"%el, "errors", len(errs), errs[:3])
    if errs: bad+=1
print("bad:", bad)
PYEOF
